'''Thaneespi''' was a [[Mon Calamari]] who served in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BMF 24" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Thaneespi was [[Executive officer|first officer]] of the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|MC80A ''Home One'' Type Heavy Star Cruiser]] ''[[Home One]]''<ref name="BMF 24" /> while present at a briefing shortly before the [[Battle of Endor]]. Prior to the meeting, where the Alliance's strategy at the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]] was discussed, Thaneespi briefly spoke with [[Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

''Home One'' then traveled to Endor,<ref name="Episode VI" /> where Thaneespi served as one of the [[commander]]s of the Alliance's [[Star Cruiser]] at the battle there.<ref name="BMF 24" /> The battle resulted in the destruction of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] and the [[death]] of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. Thaneespi had [[Color|brown-mottled]] skin, yellow [[eye]]s, and wore a [[helmet]] along with a beige [[Clothing|uniform]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thaneespi first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="Episode VI" /> and was first identified in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the "[[Starship Fact File]]" section of the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 24|twenty-fourth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'' magazine series,<ref name="BMF 24" /> written by [[Tim Veekhoven]]<ref name="SM">{{DMCite|dm=File:TimVeekhoven-Credits.png|creator=Tim Veekhoven}}</ref> and published around [[June 17]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFDates">{{BMFdates|24}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Thaneespi/Legends|Thaneespi's]] name was first revealed in the ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], released in [[2000]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=First Officer Thaneespi}}</ref>

[[File:ThaneespiHelmet-Costumes.jpg|thumb|right|135px|Thaneespi's helmet]]
The scenes on ''Home One'' were filmed throughout the week of Tuesday, [[February 16]], [[1982]].<ref name="BTS">{{WebCite|url=https://swnz.co.nz/2017/03/11/gerald-home-tessek-squid-head-mon-calamari-officer-2|text=Gerald Home as Tessek (Squid Head) and Mon Calamari Officer|author=G., Matt|date=2004-06-11|work=[https://swnz.co.nz Star Wars New Zealand]|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/JbkiZ|archivedate=2021-03-01}}</ref> The helmet worn by Thaneespi was originally intended to be worn by Admiral Ackbar, but it was given to Thaneespi as Ackbar's articulated head would have made wearing the helmet complicated.<ref name="costume">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref> The team of [[Peter Ronzani|Pete Ronzani]] was responsible for the helmet's design.<ref name="Mythe">''[[Star Wars, Objets du mythe]]''</ref>
